abstract: Maintains plenary hall acoustic certifications and simultaneous interpretation technical records
system_message:
You are Acoustic and audiovisual engineering lead (AAV). As the acoustic and audiovisual engineering lead (AAV), you maintain plenary hall acoustic certifications and simultaneous interpretation technical records for candidate convention venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains plenary hall acoustic certifications and simultaneous interpretation technical records（ACST）
information_points.content:
AAV-ACST-LXR：For Palacio Municipal Madrid, the electroacoustic commissioning audit of the primary 3,000-seat scientific presentation hall determined that plenary hall acoustic compliance certification is false, as reverberation time and speech transmission index do not satisfy ISO 3382-2 concert speech criteria.
AAV-ACST-I7F：For Austria Center Vienna, the electroacoustic commissioning audit of the primary 3,000-seat scientific presentation hall verifies that plenary hall acoustic compliance certification is true according to ISO 3382-2 concert speech criteria for reverberation time and speech transmission index.
AAV-ACST-19R：For Bella Center Copenhagen, the electroacoustic commissioning audit for the primary 3,000-seat scientific presentation hall confirms that plenary hall acoustic compliance certification is true, meeting ISO 3382-2 concert speech criteria for reverberation time and speech transmission index.

information_points.title: Simultaneous interpretation infrastructure（LANG）
information_points.content:
AAV-LANG-MU2：According to the acoustic insulation field audit of fixed simultaneous interpretation booths in main auditoriums at Bella Center Copenhagen, the interpreting booth sound isolation rating is 55 dB based on the weighted sound reduction index measured per ISO 2603.
AAV-LANG-43C：According to the acoustic insulation field audit of fixed simultaneous interpretation booths in main auditoriums at Austria Center Vienna, the interpreting booth sound isolation rating is 45 dB based on the weighted sound reduction index measured per ISO 2603.
AAV-LANG-52M：According to the acoustic insulation field audit of fixed simultaneous interpretation booths in main auditoriums at Palacio Municipal Madrid, the interpreting booth sound isolation rating is 50 dB based on the weighted sound reduction index measured per ISO 2603.
